sources.title: keys-GLM-5.3-EXL3-3.0BPW-abliterated-vLLm+cuda-Exl3 - GitHub
sources.snippet: Theory says it should. The stock DFlash2 drafter was trained against GLM-5.3 in full precision; this target is the same model at EXL3 3.0 bpw, and a third-party KLD measurement puts that checkpoint at mean KL 0.102 nats against BF16 with 91.1% top-1 agreement — roughly one argmax decision in eleven differs from the unquantized model.
